commands.name: Disable Cortana
commands.script: New-Item 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search' -Force | Out-Null; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search' -Name AllowCortana -Value 0 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search' -Name DisableWebSearch -Value 1 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search' -Name ConnectedSearchUseWeb -Value 0 -Type DWord

commands.name: Disable Windows consumer features (suggested apps, tips)
commands.script: New-Item 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent' -Force | Out-Null; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent' -Name DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures -Value 1 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent' -Name DisableThirdPartySuggestions -Value 1 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent' -Name DisableSoftLanding -Value 1 -Type DWord

commands.name: Uninstall OneDrive
commands.script: Get-Process OneDrive -EA 0 | Stop-Process -Force -EA 0; $od = if (Test-Path "$env:SystemRoot\SysWOW64\OneDriveSetup.exe") { "$env:SystemRoot\SysWOW64\OneDriveSetup.exe" } else { "$env:SystemRoot\System32\OneDriveSetup.exe" }; if (Test-Path $od) { Start-Process $od '/uninstall' -Wait -NoNewWindow }; New-Item 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\OneDrive' -Force | Out-Null; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\OneDrive' -Name DisableFileSyncNGSC -Value 1 -Type DWord

commands.name: Remove Microsoft bloatware Appx packages
commands.script: $bloat=@('Microsoft.BingWeather','Microsoft.BingNews','Microsoft.BingSearch','Microsoft.GetHelp','Microsoft.Getstarted','Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection','Microsoft.People','Microsoft.SkypeApp','Microsoft.WindowsFeedbackHub','Microsoft.WindowsMaps','Microsoft.YourPhone','Microsoft.ZuneMusic','Microsoft.ZuneVideo','Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub','Microsoft.Microsoft3DViewer','Microsoft.MixedReality.Portal'); foreach($n in $bloat){ Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers $n -EA 0 | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -EA 0; Get-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online -EA 0 | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -eq $n } | Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online -EA 0 | Out-Null }
